kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi delete-defense-rule --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --rule-ids 2223455,23354,465565 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteDefenseRule

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the protection template to delete.
This parameter is required only when DefenseType is set to template
parameters.help_zh:
要删除的防护模板ID。
仅当 DefenseType 为 template 时，需要传入该参数
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the protection rules to delete. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 要删除的防护规则ID，多个防护规则ID之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: rule_ids

parameters.help_en: The type of the protection rule
parameters.name: defense_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the DryRun dry run mode. If you do not specify this parameter, a normal request is sent. Valid values:
true: A dry run request is sent. The system checks whether the request meets the execution conditions without performing the specified operation. If the dry run fails, the corresponding error code is returned. If the dry run succeeds, the error code Defense.Control.DryRunOperation is returned.
false: A normal request is sent. The specified operation is performed after the request passes the check
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启 DryRun 预检模式。如果不输入该参数，表示发起正常请求。取值：
true：表示发起预检请求，仅检查请求是否满足执行条件，不执行请求指定的操作。预检不通过时返回相应错误码；预检通过时返回错误码Defense.Control.DryRunOperation。
false：表示发起正常请求；检查通过后执行请求指定的操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The protected object associated with the rule to delete.
This parameter is required only when DefenseType is set to resource
parameters.help_zh:
要删除规则对应的防护对象。
仅当 DefenseType 为 resource 时，需要传入该参数
parameters.name: resource
